Pricing is transparent, and most packages are eligible for insurance reimbursement. Package categories Annual physical — tailored by age and gender Cardiac screening — ECG, vascular assessment Cancer screening — breast, cervical, colorectal, liver Antenatal care — from conception through delivery Vaccination — adult, pediatric, senior Surgical & treatment packages — fixed-price transparent pricing Pre-travel medical screening Senior wellness — full multi-system check Why Phyathai packages Each package is designed by Phyathai's specialist physicians and delivered with modern equipment and technology. Pricing is transparent with no hidden fees, multiple payment options are supported, and the booking system handles both Thai and international patients. As part of the BDMS network, Phyathai operates across multiple branches in Bangkok. Phyathai Hospital branches The Phyathai Hospital group operates six hospitals across Bangkok and the Eastern Seaboard, with care coordinated across the network so patients can move seamlessly between facilities for specialist services.
